trigger: Equipped or carried preset light armor, main phase with an action

choices: Begin or continue donning, begin or continue doffing, cancel work

trigger: Equipped or carried preset scale mail, main phase with an action

choices: Begin or continue donning, begin or continue doffing, cancel work

trigger: Equipped or carried preset chain mail, main phase with an action
cost: 10 minutes to don and 5 minutes to doff, 100 and 50 own turns; a standard bout can start either task without enough time to finish
choices: Begin or continue donning, begin or continue doffing, cancel work

rule_source: Arena timing adjudication for SRD 5.2 multi-turn armor work
cost: Action and uninterrupted turn to make progress
choices: Continue on consecutive own turns or cancel; moving, a different committed action, incapacitation, or taking damage interrupts work

trigger: Stealth check with scale mail or chain mail equipped
choices: Keep armor and accept disadvantage, or remove it and lose its AC bonus

trigger: Mage Armor attempted while wearing armor or completing donning after Mage Armor is active
cost: Mage Armor is inapplicable while wearing body armor; donning ends an active spell
choices: Normal action and slot when eligible

trigger: Choose drop equipment before a form change
cost: Dropping uses the Wild Shape action; later pickup uses free interaction or Utilize
choices: Leave body armor at original cell; after reverting retrieve then don

trigger: Pick up a transferable dropped suit and complete donning
cost: Suited category duration; no spells and disadvantage on STR/DEX d20 tests when untrained; Chain Mail strength minimum changes speed
choices: Pick up, drop, select suit, don or doff; no effect from packed armor

trigger: Wield an issued or borrowed shield
cost: Utilize to don or doff; +2 AC only with shield training
choices: Doff and stow or hold loose, release or pick up, don; Command Drop affects loose shields
